### Prayer for a Dark Land
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/prayer-for-a-dark-land-one-year-devotions-for-men-october-15.html
Passage: Psalm 74:1-2
Points:
- In seasons of ruin and exile, believers often struggle with feelings that God may have abandoned them permanently.
- The history of redemption demonstrates that the Lord remains willing to forgive, revive, and restore His people.
- Prayer can boldly appeal to God's past deliverances, His covenant promises, and the honor of His name.
- Believers are called to intercede persistently rather than simply bemoaning the darkness and violence of the world.
- God begins renewal with His people, using the humble and needy to be active agents of His work.
